<thought>The mass spectrum shows a protonated molecular ion at m/z 180.042, indicating a neutral monoisotopic mass of about 179.035 Da. Matching this mass to elemental compositions, C₉H₇O₄ gives an exact mass of 179.034435 Da, only ~0.5 mDa off (≈3 ppm). The isotopic pattern (≈10 % M+1) is consistent with nine carbons and no significant halogen or nitrogen contributions. Therefore the molecular formula is C₉H₇O₄.</thought>
<final_answer>C9H7O4</final_answer>
